service.method:
SELECT A.* , COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY MENU_ID) CNT FROM ( SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.MENU_ID , PDLANG.CONTENTS MENU_NAME , MUPD.MENU_SEQ , MUPD.SCREEN_ID , IDLANG.CONTENTS SCREEN_NAME , MUPD.ITEM_SEQ , MUID.URL , MUID.AUTH_URL , MUID.MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUPD.ETC_FLAG
, MUPD.ICON_TYPE
, MUID.HIDDEN_FLAG FROM SMUPD MUPD LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = PDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG.CODE AND PDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU_' || MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND PDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG IDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = IDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = IDLANG.CODE AND IDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU' AND IDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUID MUID ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = MUID.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = MUID.SCREEN_ID AND MUID.PARENT_ID = '*' WHERE MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${profile_no} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUPD.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUID.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUPD.HIDDEN_FLAG,'N') <> $S{HIDDEN_FLAG} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUID.HIDDEN_FLAG,'N') <> $S{HIDDEN_FLAG} AND (MUPD.SCREEN_ID = '*' OR MUID.SCREEN_ID is not null) UNION ALL SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.MENU_ID , PDLANG.CONTENTS MENU_NAME , MUPD.MENU_SEQ , MUPD.SCREEN_ID , IDLANG.CONTENTS SCREEN_NAME , MUPD.ITEM_SEQ , MUID.URL , MUID.AUTH_URL , MUID.MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUPD.ETC_FLAG
, MUPD.ICON_TYPE
, MUID.HIDDEN_FLAG FROM SMUPD MUPD LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = PDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG.CODE AND PDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU' AND PDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG IDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = IDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = IDLANG.CODE AND IDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU' AND IDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUID MUID ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = MUID.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = MUID.SCREEN_ID AND MUID.PARENT_ID = '*' WHERE MENU_PROFILE_CODE = 'COMMON' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUPD.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N') A ORDER BY CASE WHEN MENU_PROFILE_CODE='COMMON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ,(SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(NVL(MENU_SEQ,'0'),'99999999999')) FROM SMUPD WHERE SMUPD.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND SMUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = A.MENU_PROFILE_CODE) , TO_NUMBER(NVL(MENU_SEQ,'0'),'99999999999') , TO_NUMBER(ITEM_SEQ,'99999999999')
